# liboqs / fuzz_test_sig

liboqs's own fuzz target `fuzz_test_sig` ([source](source/fuzz_test_sig.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over liboqs (open-quantum-safe/liboqs at 8979276a).

Checks one property, a self-validation: A signature just produced by OQS_SIG_sign over the fuzz message (fuzz-selected algorithm, fuzz-seeded RNG keypair) must verify with OQS_SIG_verify under the matching public key.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against liboqs at commit 8979276a.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- A signature just produced by OQS_SIG_sign over the fuzz message (fuzz-selected algorithm, fuzz-seeded RNG keypair) must verify with OQS_SIG_verify under the matching public key ([lines 102-108](source/fuzz_test_sig.c#L102-L108)): exit(1); not confirmed in the binary.
